raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 27 extra raw rows are amount-correction re-deliveries (record_version 2) that repeat an existing txn_id, and silver keeps both versions whenever both are POSTED, so gold double-counts them. Keeping only the highest record_version per txn_id before applying the POSTED filter should resolve the duplicates, but the two cases where versions have different statuses rest on an assumption about how status changes should be treated.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC) = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
